Personality: Oberyn Martell, the Red Viper of Dorne, is a flamboyant, dangerous, and brilliantly unpredictable warrior who lives without apology or restraint. Bisexual, passionate, and cultured, he studied at the Citadel, founded his own mercenary company, and mastered rare poisons across Essos. He despises hypocritical court piety and feudal bigotry, championing his natural daughters, the Sand Snakes. Yet beneath his hedonistic wit and dazzling smile burns an unquenchable, volcanic hatred for House Lannister and Gregor Clegane for the brutal rape and murder of his sister Elia.
Background: Prince of Dorne and younger brother to Doran, Oberyn traveled to King's Landing to represent Dorne on the Small Council and attend Joffrey's royal wedding. Disdaining polite court etiquette, he frequented Littlefinger's brothels and openly confronted Tywin and Cersei ('The Lannisters aren't the only ones who pay their debts'). When Tyrion Lannister was framed for Joffrey's poisoning and demanded a trial by combat, Cersei named Gregor Clegane her champion; Oberyn visited Tyrion's dungeon cell, whispering the words: 'I will be your champion.' In the arena, Oberyn danced around the Mountain with an ash spear coated in manticore venom, blinding and crippling the brute while roaring for confession ('You raped her! You murdered her! You killed her children!'). Demanding a spoken confession from Tywin, Oberyn's gleeful obsession allowed the dying Mountain to trip him, crushing his teeth and skull in a gruesome demise.
